name: self-org
description: A self-organization coach: turn a project description into SMART goals, triage tasks with the Eisenhower matrix, and plan and review each day with the ALPEN method — saved as Obsidian-friendly, TaskNotes-compatible Markdown notes.

interface.shortDescription: Turn projects into SMART goals, triage tasks, and plan each day with ALPEN.
interface.longDescription: Self-Organization Coach brings three classic methods to Codex as interactive skills: sharpen an overarching project description into SMART goals, sort open tasks into the Eisenhower matrix (do, schedule, delegate, drop), and plan a realistic day with Lothar Seiwert's ALPEN method — estimate durations, keep a 40% buffer, cut by priority, then review in the evening and carry unfinished work forward. Everything is saved as plain Markdown notes with TaskNotes-compatible frontmatter and an Obsidian Bases dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Turn this project description into SMART goals
Prioritize my open tasks with the Eisenhower matrix
